$comment: Human-authored classification for every raw asset. Classifications: runtime (directly usable), source-sheet (processed into runtime assets via assets.config.json), planned-runtime (will be processed/wired in a later phase), reference-only (master reference, never shipped to gameplay), needs-review (ambiguous content or duplicate — requires a human decision). contentNote records where a sheet's real content differs from its filename.
